title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text: ‘stresses, however, that no formal process to establish any such initiative has yet been launched and that the question of its location can only be addressed once the General Assembly has decided on its mandate, form, governance and financing;  encourages Member States to coordinate so that European proposals reinforce each other, and to explore how a future structure could work in a network with the existing UN presence in the EU;’
